name: xoga713-combined-var-multfactor-date-filter
description: Combined VAR rule: the multFactor reference reads helper_var_mult_factor_view only for the value dates that are in helper_var_accounting_report, instead of every product for every FX date.

steps.where: template_name IN ('Combined VAR','Combined VAR pipeline') AND rule_data->'referenceRegistry'->'references'->'multFactor'->>'query' = 'SELECT invenio_product_code, value_date, lot_mult, curr_mult, mult_factor FROM opera.helper_var_mult_factor_view'

set.rule_data: jsonb_set(rule_data, '{referenceRegistry,references,multFactor,query}', to_jsonb('SELECT m.invenio_product_code, m.value_date, m.lot_mult, m.curr_mult, m.mult_factor FROM opera.helper_var_mult_factor_view m WHERE m.value_date IN (SELECT a.value_date FROM opera.helper_var_accounting_report a GROUP BY a.value_date)'::text))
